youtube_short.description: In the first years of a 30-year mortgage, 86% of every payment goes to interest — not your home. After 5 years on a $350K loan you've paid $136,000 but only own $20,500 more of your house. Banks front-load it on purpose. The flip side: paying just $200 extra per month saves $51,000 and cuts 6 years off your loan. Pull up your amortization schedule today. #mortgage #personalfinance #homebuying #realestate #moneytips
